route_title: 16-Layer Smoothness-Constrained Quadratic Chirp with Boundary Stabilization
compilation_rationale: Fixed 16-layer HfO2/SiO2 stack compiled with boundary layers pinned at 75.0 nm. Inner 12 layers bounded to 37.5–112.5 nm around quarter-wave starting thickness. Chirp parameterization and |Δd|≤25 nm smoothness enforced via optimizer backend constraints. Dual-band soft objectives drive transmission maximization in 1530–1565 nm and reflection maximization in 400–700 nm.
